lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 103910112 · After Temporary Professional Maid chat 2. Cocoa has invited Ade to join the group.

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: Mwahahahaha!

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: Girls!

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: It's Valentine's Day,

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: so you've got to work extra hard.

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: As for me, I'm heading back to being a full-time villain, mwahaha!

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: I went to bed early last night so I could be energized for the special occasion,

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: because today, my friends, is a cheat day!

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: I'm gonna be doing what a villain does best:

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: slacking off and clocking out early!

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: You all owe me big time for helping out, by the way.

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: Sooner or later, I'm gonna...

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Goodbye, Drake :)

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: You saw all that?!

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: I thought I'd be able to rattle these messages off before anyone got off work.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Everyone else is busy while I'm resting,

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: so I'm the only one who has time to see your messages.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: You really did a great job helping us out.

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: No,

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: it's nothing.

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: However,

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: you still owe me.

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: You're in my debt, and sooner or later, I'll come to collect.

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: Until then, keep your nose to the grindstone!

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Sounds good :)

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: I'll be expecting you.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Take care!

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: No, YOU take care.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Will do.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Thanks again for all your hard work.

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: Save your gratitude for when you pay off your debt.

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: Poor you... you'll be a maid for the rest of your life.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Haha,

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: that's the greatest compliment anyone's ever given me!
